tolerance_precedence: Per-item tolerance is canonical. There is no widening global tolerance. Defaults apply only when an item omits a tolerance, and v3 canonical GT does not omit required tolerances.
point_event_matching: candidate time must fall in [last_absent - tolerance_before, first_present + tolerance_after], type and actor must match, and ordering invariants also apply
state_interval_matching: detector must cover at least min_core_coverage of core_interval; outer_interval minus core_interval is dont-care; detections outside outer_interval count as overreach only where the interval is marked exhaustive
snapshot_matching: nearest output snapshot inside ±tolerance_sec must match every explicitly listed expected field; unspecified fields are not asserted
unknown_policy: Unspecified facts are neither positive nor negative assertions unless an exhaustive region explicitly closes the world for the listed category.
leakage_policy: Runtime may read inputs/e2e_inputs.json and source video only. ground_truth/, assets/, and generated assertions are evaluation-side only.
frame_pts_policy: Evidence filenames carry requested container times; frame_pts_sidecar_v3.json carries nearest exact packet PTS and must stay within one frame of the requested time.
discontinuity_policy: No temporal feature with a start/end interval may cross a known discontinuity. Evaluator consumes output.temporal_features to enforce this.
ownership_policy: Ownership intervals are first-class assertions; player-owned mechanics during self_dead_ui/teammate_spectated windows fail through negatives.
confidence_policy: This single fixture checks numeric/domain sanity only. Statistical calibration metrics are advisory until multiple fixtures are accumulated.
